The tool will help Fedora stand out as a security-conscious distro with intelligent log handling. Deliverables 1. Source Code Repository: Python/Bash scripts, ML models, and log parsing logic. 2. Packaged RPM: A user-installable package for Fedora. 3. Documentation: Installation, configuration, usage, developer guide. 4. Prototype/CLI: Real-time demo showcasing live classification and prioritization. 5. Testing & Evaluation: Unit/integration tests, model benchmarks. Timeline Community Bonding ●
